prerequisites: No formal prerequisites. Competencies from the basic modules Object-oriented Programming, Algorithms and Data Structures, and the advanced module Software Engineering are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can systematically develop a larger software system following a defined software development process.
Students can design a larger software system.
Students have in-depth knowledge of modeling and programming.
Students can work in a structured manner in a team over a longer period.
Students can perform guided project management tasks according to software engineering principles.
Students can present work and project results.

syllabus_topics: Design of a larger software system based on modern concepts and tools of software engineering
Implementation of a larger software system based on modern concepts and tools of software engineering
Quality assurance of a larger software system based on modern concepts and tools of software engineering
Documentation of a larger software system based on modern concepts and tools of software engineering
Iterative software development, with each iteration stage concluding with a milestone acceptance

assessment_methods.method: Software creation (including program code, planning documents, user and developer manuals, and presentation material)

assessment_rules: The module is ungraded according to the examination regulations for the B.Sc. Computer Science program. Assessment includes software creation, mandatory attendance, and a presentation of the created software.
